text:
sqlpipe is a command-line tool that syncs data from Postgres tables to S3. The tool writes the data as Parquet files. You run sqlpipe from a terminal. The tool reads rows from a Postgres database and writes them to an S3 bucket. Each table becomes a separate Parquet file.

This tool helps you move data from a database to object storage. You can use the data for analysis or for a backup. sqlpipe reads your configuration and connects to the database. Then sqlpipe exports each table to S3. You can schedule sqlpipe to run at regular intervals. This schedule keeps an up-to-date copy of your data in S3.
